question: Why is there no expansion or devouring satisfaction here?
premises: even restraint is not in this free-from-contraction state
because of its absence there is no expansion
devouring and satisfaction are likewise not here
inference: in the state free from contraction, restraint, expansion, devouring, and satisfaction do not apply
plain_english: Even restraint is not in this state free from contraction; because of its absence there is no expansion, nor devouring and satisfaction likewise here.
